Linda Park (9:05 A.M.)
Omar, are you already at the Westfield office? The client meeting was moved up to 10:00.
Omar Haddad (9:08 A.M.)
Not yet. I'm stuck behind a stalled truck on Route 9. I've barely moved in fifteen minutes.
Linda Park (9:10 A.M.)
Should I ask Ms. Ortiz to start the presentation without you?
Omar Haddad (9:12 A.M.)
I'd rather you didn't. The pricing slides are on my laptop.
Linda Park (9:13 A.M.)
Understood. I'll offer the clients coffee and a tour of the showroom first. Text me when you park.

questions.content: Why is Mr. Haddad late?
options: He went to the wrong office.
He is waiting for a client.
questions.explanation: Lúc 9:08 Mr. Haddad viết 'I'm stuck behind a stalled truck on Route 9' – kẹt xe → (A). Không có chi tiết xe hỏng, đi nhầm văn phòng hay đang chờ khách.

questions.content: At 9:12 A.M., what does Mr. Haddad most likely mean when he writes, "I'd rather you didn't"?
options: He prefers that the presentation wait for him.
He does not want Ms. Park to call him.
He thinks the meeting should be canceled.
He would like Ms. Ortiz to discuss the prices.
questions.explanation: Ms. Park hỏi có nên để Ms. Ortiz bắt đầu thuyết trình không; anh trả lời 'I'd rather you didn't' và giải thích slide giá nằm trong laptop của mình → muốn chờ anh tới (A). Ms. Park sau đó cho khách đi xem showroom trước, nên cuộc họp không bị huỷ.

passage:
Brightwater Fitness Center
Notice to Members
The indoor pool will be closed from June 3 to June 21 while new tiles and a heating system are installed. During this period, members may use the pool at our Harbor Street location at no extra charge; simply show your membership card at the front desk.
Group swimming lessons scheduled for June will be moved to July, and instructors will contact participants directly. The locker rooms, sauna, and weight room will remain open throughout the renovation.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
Brightwater Management

questions.content: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To explain a change in opening hours
questions.explanation: Câu đầu: 'The indoor pool will be closed from June 3 to June 21' – thông báo đóng cửa tạm thời → (A).

questions.content: What are members who want to swim in June advised to do?
options: Sign up for lessons in July
Call the front desk in advance
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'members may use the pool at our Harbor Street location at no extra charge' → sang cơ sở khác (C). 'no extra charge' nên không phải trả thêm phí.

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned as remaining available during the renovation?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 liệt kê 'The locker rooms, sauna, and weight room will remain open'; quầy nước ép không được nhắc tới → (D).

passage:
Grace Liu [2:01 P.M.]
Quick update on the Midwest Home Expo: the organizers just moved our booth from Hall A to Hall C.
Tomas Varga [2:03 P.M.]
Hall C is next to the food court, isn't it? That should bring a lot more visitors past our display.
Priya Nair [2:04 P.M.]
Maybe, but the booths there are smaller. Will our new sofa models still fit?
Grace Liu [2:06 P.M.]
I checked. The space is about two meters narrower, so we can bring only three of the four models.
Ben Adler [2:07 P.M.]
Leave the recliner here, then. It's the bulkiest piece, and it's already featured in our catalog.
Priya Nair [2:08 P.M.]
Fine by me. I'll update the floor plan and send it to the shipping company this afternoon.
Grace Liu [2:09 P.M.]
Thanks, Priya. The truck is scheduled to leave our warehouse on Thursday morning.

questions.content: What did the expo organizers recently do?
options: They changed the dates of the expo.
They assigned the company a different space.
They increased the booth rental fee.
They moved the food court next to the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Ms. Liu (2:01): 'the organizers just moved our booth from Hall A to Hall C' → đổi vị trí gian hàng (B).

questions.content: At 2:07 P.M., what does Mr. Adler most likely mean when he writes, "Leave the recliner here, then"?
options: A customer has already bought the recliner.
The recliner should be placed near the entrance.
One product should not be sent to the expo.
questions.explanation: Gian hàng mới chỉ chứa được 3 trong 4 mẫu; Mr. Adler đề nghị để chiếc recliner lại kho vì cồng kềnh nhất → không mang sản phẩm này đi hội chợ (C).

questions.content: What type of business do the writers most likely work for?
questions.explanation: Họ bàn về 'our new sofa models' và chiếc recliner trong catalog của công ty → công ty nội thất (A). Ban tổ chức và công ty vận chuyển là bên khác được nhắc tới.

questions.content: What will Ms. Nair do this afternoon?
options: Measure the booth in Hall C
Revise a layout and share it with a carrier
Load the truck at the warehouse
questions.explanation: Ms. Nair (2:08): 'I'll update the floor plan and send it to the shipping company this afternoon' → sửa sơ đồ và gửi cho bên vận chuyển (B).

passage:
Local Bakery Expands to Second Location
GREENVILLE (May 14) — Rosemary Lane Bakery, known for its sourdough loaves and seasonal fruit tarts, will open a second shop on Clifton Avenue next month. — [1] — Owner Hannah Brooks started the business eight years ago in a small kitchen behind her home.
"Demand has grown steadily, especially from cafés and restaurants that buy our bread wholesale," said Ms. Brooks. — [2] — The new shop will contain a larger oven that will allow the bakery to triple its daily output.
The Clifton Avenue location will also have seating for about twenty customers, something the original shop lacks. — [3] — Ms. Brooks plans to hire six additional bakers and two counter staff before the opening. — [4] — Applications can be submitted through the bakery's Web site.

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề và câu đầu: tiệm bánh 'will open a second shop on Clifton Avenue' → mở rộng kinh doanh (C).

questions.content: The word "output" in paragraph 2, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'triple its daily output' = tăng gấp ba sản lượng mỗi ngày (lò lớn hơn) → output = production (B).

questions.content: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Customers will be able to enjoy coffee and pastries there as well."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn nói khách có thể dùng cà phê, bánh 'there' – nối tiếp câu về khu ghế ngồi cho 20 khách ở cửa hàng mới → vị trí [3] (C).

questions.content: Which workshop does Mr. Okoro want his team to attend?

questions.content: What will Mr. Okoro's company most likely receive?

questions.content: Why is Mr. Okoro's team taking the workshop?
options: To learn how to use the new accounting software tools
To prepare for meetings with potential customers
questions.explanation: E-mail: 'We are preparing for a series of client pitches next month' → chuẩn bị thuyết trình với khách hàng (C).

questions.content: What does Mr. Okoro ask about?
options: The location of the Lakewood office
A place to leave a vehicle
The start time of the workshop

options: It was placed a week early.
Fairmont Architects is a regular customer.
It was for more than twenty people.

questions.content: What did Ms. Tanaka's clients particularly like?

questions.content: What does Ms. Tanaka request?

A change to a delivery address
